Class Transaction

  • java.lang.Object
    • .Transaction
  • Direct Known Subclasses:
    Expense, Income 

    public abstract class Transaction
extends java.lang.Object
    An abstract base class for all financial movements (Income and Expense). Provides common attributes like amount, date, and notes.
